script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for November 27. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Rights are what you're owed.  Responsibilities are what you owe.  Yesterday we explored rights; today we flip the coin.

Responsibilities extend in all directions: to yourself (taking care of your wellbeing), to others (honoring commitments), to community (contributing to shared life). Each domain matters. Some responsibilities are chosen—promises you make, roles you accept.  Others are inherited—family, citizenship, humanity.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Rights and responsibilities are inseparable.  Claiming one requires honoring the other.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Responsibility Audit - What Do You Owe?.

Here's your activity: List your responsibilities—to yourself, to specific people, to your community. Which are you fulfilling well? Which are you neglecting? Choose one responsibility to strengthen this week. This helps you clarify and honor responsibilities.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about what you owe others can be applied to responsibility audit - what do you owe?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
